headline: Desai & Diwanji, Fox & Mandal act on Bombay Coated & Special Steels ₹185 crore IPO

detail: Bombay Coated & Special Steels Limited has raised ₹185 crore from an initial public offering of equity shares comprised entirely of a fresh issue. Desai & Diwanji advised Bombay Coated & Special Steels on this IPO, according to the red herring prospectus. Fox & Mandal advised Smart Horizon Capital Advisors Private Limited, the book running lead manager on this IPO. The transaction team consisted of Prashaant Vikram Rajput (Partner), Rudresh Mandal (Principal Associate), Shrinwantu Choudhury (Associate), and Saumy Bhowmick (Associate).
